metal.role: noise to metallic oscillator/ring cluster blend

shape.role: oscillator spread/ring complexity plus transient sharpness

choke.role: open-to-closed interaction from none through fade to hard exclusive

event_semantics: A closed trigger does not simply steal the open voice: the shared kernel retains open-envelope state and applies the latched Choke law. A new open trigger clears stale choke state. Synthesis controls latch at onset; Choke is sampled by the closed onset that performs the choke.
reference_family: Hexinverter/Erica Synths Mutant Hi-Hats; TR-808-derived electro-hat architecture with expanded drive/filter/source/choke behavior. No circuit-recovery or clone claim.
samples: None in runtime DSP. Reference MP3s are offline listening/analysis evidence only.
